text.p: Here are highlights from Polish newspapers this morning. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
POLITICAL NEWS RZECZPOSPOLITA

- The co-ruling ex-communist Social-Democracy of the Republic of Poland (SDRP) has promised to pay two million zlotys in repayment of debts of the communist Polish United Workers Party (PZPR), the party's secretary general Jerzy Szmajdzinski said.
ECONOMIC AND MARKET STORIES RZECZPOSPOLITA

- The Labour Court of Szczecin in north-western Poland, has ruled for arresting the German Andreas Pakula vessel now in the port of Szczecin as a result of pay arrears worth $90,000 owed to the crew by the shipowner.

- The following pharamceutical concerns: Norway's Nycomed and two international giants Bristol Myers Squibb and Glaxo Wellcome have been shortlisted for privatisation of the Polfa pharmaceutics plant in Poznan, western Poland, the treasury ministry said.

- German police of the Saxony province has bought a Sokol helicopter made by the PZL Swidnik plant in eastern Poland. The chopper is furnished with the US-made King Bendix computer avionics system and is the first of 20 aircraft to be exported in 1997, Swidnik said.

- The following distilleries: ZPS in Wroclaw, SWW Polmos in Szczecin, LZPS in Lancut, ZPS in Krakow, ZPS in Bielsko Biala, ZPS Polmos in Starogard, have applied for changing their status into state-owned joint stock companies, the distilleries said.

- Poland's treasury ministry has sold a 51 percent stake in the Milfor tank and brewery equipment maker in Olsztyn, north-eastern Poland, worth 2.5 million zlotys to Veri-Service of Warsaw, the ministry said.
- The privately-owned Netia Telecom has launched a new telephone exchange in Bedzin municipality, southern Poland, Netia said.

- The general shareholders' meeting of the Bank Gospodarki Zywnosciowej (BGZ) agricultural sector bank on August 28 will vote on a share capital increase by between 10 million zlotys and 40 million zlotys, the bank's deputy president Jaroslaw Biernacki s aid.

- The general shareholders meeting of the state owned Orbis travel agency and hotel chain operator voted for a share capital increase to 92.047 million zlotys by 17.047 million zlotys at a meeting on June 27, the firm said.
DZIENNIK PRAWA I GOSPODARKI

- The envoys of the Kuwait Investment Authority have arrived in Poland to discuss participation in the privatisation of the Nafta Polska fuel distribution co-ordinator, the economy deputy minster Jan Chaladaj said.
- More than 10,000 Seat vehicles, mostly Cordoba and Ibiza passenger car models, were sold in the first six months in Poland, Seat car dealers said.

- The Piast SA brewery in south-western Poland has decided to pay a voluntary tax of 0.01 zloty per each sold bottle of beer to support the victims of recent floods and hopes other companies will do the same, Piast said.
GAZETA WYBORCZA

- The Polish Banking Association (ZBP) has opposed the recent decision of the National Bank of Poland (BP), the central bank, to launch retail banking services. The decision may lead to a breakdown of the country's banking system, ZBA said.
- Warta insurance firm earned a net profit of 15.2 million zlotys on gross premiums of 576.9 million zlotys in the first half of 1997, the company said.
PARKIET
- The listed Budimex construction firm will issue 4,053,500 B-series shares priced at four zlotys per share, Budimex said.
- The WKSM aggregate mine's shares were traded at 70 zlotys per share on the first day of continuous trading on the Warsaw bourse, showing a 58 percent growth compared with the public offer price.
